QuestInfo.name: Shammos's Regained Memory
QuestInfo.0: #bShammos#k is calling on you again. Has he regained his lost memories?
QuestInfo.1: Go see Shammos, who's in the basement of the Chief's Residence in El Nath.
QuestInfo.2: Shammos seems to have something he wants to say to you...

0.0: The missing pages were a great help. I think I'm starting to understand who I am. But still, my memory comes and goes. While I write this, I am sane. But who knows when I'll lose my mind again. I have a bad feeling about all of this. If what I've learned so far is correct, something very dangerous is about to happen. I need your help, friend! \r\n#bFrom Shammos

1.0: It is good to see you, #h0#, my friend. It is strange. The more I remember, the stranger I feel. And this strange feeling makes me want to go insane. That's why I wrote to you.
